profile_text.body:
Seagate Technology Holdings plc describes itself as a leader in mass-capacity data storage. The company says it has delivered more than four billion terabytes of capacity over the past four decades and makes storage that scales, bringing trust and integrity to innovations that depend on data.

On AI, Seagate states that AI is accelerating data growth and reshaping storage requirements. It says it is optimizing storage for AI and making capacity increases to support efficient data center architecture and buildout.

Seagate is a for-profit public company traded under the ticker STX, headquartered in Singapore, with SEC CIK 0001137789.
